calc.spot_why: Spot is the CRYPTO NOVA portfolio, with no leverage. The core — Bitcoin 30%, Ether 10%, Solana 5% — is held for the long run; coins the table marks «can buy» get 7.5% each with a −20% stop; risky ones 2.5% each; at least 10% stays in dollars. At most 8 coins including the core.
calc.cash_why: The system always keeps at least 10% of the portfolio in dollars: that is what it uses to top up the core in dips.
calc.active_why: Active spot is «BTC momentum»: when Bitcoin rises 2.5% or more in an hour, the system buys the most liquid altcoins on spot — they usually catch up. No leverage, up to 5 positions, exit after 12 hours.
calc.futures_why: Futures are CRYPTO NOVA's selected signals: only strategies that passed the test on history trade this account. Every trade has a stop; the risk is 1% of the account per trade, and the main strategy holds no more than 4 trades at once. Losses happen too: the stop closes a losing trade. CRYPTO NOVA's real account since 22 Oct 2026: 1 futures trades closed, 1 of them in profit.

moved.label: Reallocation between spot and futures
moved.why_ru: This is not a money transfer, a fee, or a profit or loss. Spot and futures run on one OKX account with the same USDT. The system splits the account's current value, not its starting value: spot 65%, futures 25%, active spot 10%. So futures now get $18.35 less than their starting share plus their own result, and spot gets the same amount more. Of this difference, −$31.09 is the futures' share of the change in the whole account's value, and +$12.74 is how the shares drifted between recalculations: coin prices move all the time, and the system rebalances only when the gap passes a threshold.

error.title: Error
error.text: A step didn't go through: for example, the exchange rejected the identity check, the deposit didn't arrive, or copying isn't available in your country.
error.next: Check the reason in OKX, fix it there and repeat the step. If it doesn't work, contact support.

unverifiable.title: Can't be checked from the app
unverifiable.text: CRYPTO NOVA has no technical link to your OKX account, so the app can't see whether copying is on. This is not an error.
unverifiable.next: Check it yourself in OKX: “Copy trading” → “My copies”: CRYPTO NOVA should be there with the status “active”.
